justification: The council-wide not-mapped notice listed chapter names in one sentence with no reason and no link. Users asked for a brief, plain explanation for every rule we cannot place: each part now shows the plan's name for it, one plain sentence on why we cannot tell, and a link to the plan page.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/components/compliance/DcpNotCoveredNotice.test.tsx; python -m pytest -q tests/test_not_covered_councils_drift.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A chapter renders without its reason sentence, a link is built without a URL, or the shared file drifts from the source.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: one sentence, names only (DcpNotCoveredNotice on main).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Reason codes taken from each entry's recorded reason; pages from the entries' own page citations (spot-checked: Marrickville 2.22 p6 = provision 246992's pdf_page).

pre_impl.existing_data: Reuses MAY_APPLY_REASONS sentences and meta.chapter_pdf_urls already in the response.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Some entries fit no code exactly; WORDS_ONLY used as the closest honest one (Leichhardt Amendment 1, Parramatta, Ashfield D). CB 2.2 and 6.2 corrected to DRAWING_NOT_MATCHED in review.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new reason code PART_MAPPED; no new component.

functions.name: DcpNotCoveredNotice
functions.input: the council's not-covered chapters with reason codes and the chapter PDF urls
functions.output: one line per chapter: name, plain reason, plan link when a url exists
functions.if_none: no chapters at all means nothing is rendered

break_it.scenario: A chapter has no PDF url.
break_it.what_happens: A broken or empty link would be shown to the user.
break_it.how: planHref returns null and no link is rendered.
break_it.repro: jest DcpNotCoveredNotice test 'no link without url'

break_it.scenario: A chapter carries an unknown reason code.
break_it.what_happens: The line would show no explanation.
break_it.how: reason_text omitted; the name and plan link still show.

break_it.scenario: Liability wording in the new copy.
break_it.what_happens: Text could read as an assurance about the property.
break_it.how: Copy says 'we could not tell' and 'read them in the plan'; liability check passed on commit.
break_it.repro: grep the component for the pre-pr-review word list

mutation_analysis: Removing the reason line or the link fails the extended notice test.

post_merge.manual_verify: Open a Canterbury-Bankstown address page: the notice lists each part with a reason and a plan link.

residual_risk: The lead sentence says their rules are not listed; for PART_MAPPED items houses on the map do get them (the item's own reason line says so).
